notes: The second «حدثنا آدم حدثنا شعبة وزاد فخيرت من زوجها» is another isnad with an addition to the saying: a variant group (rule 4), not a route.
«أن عائشة، أرادت أن تشتري» — Aisha's action is described in the story: not a link (rule 6). Last link is الأسود.
The second saying («وأتي النبي ... بلحم») continues the same isnad: one saying-with-isnad, no saying label.
